_comment: Curated knowledge for the BUB1B / MVA1 genotype class. Scores are expert judgements with rationale; every entry carries references (keys into 'references'). Hypotheses for follow-up, not treatment advice.

A1.label: Nonsense allele (V1) provides no functional BUBR1

B2.label: Truncated product lacks the pseudokinase domain and PP2A-B56 recruitment

A2.label: Missense allele (V2) provides no sufficient BUBR1

B3.label: Destabilised pseudokinase fold lowers protein level

B4.label: Reduced hyperphosphorylation and kinetochore PP2A-B56 function (inferred from the domain)

C_TOP.label: Systemic harm from chronic chromosomal instability

Cq2.label: Micronuclei, cGAS-STING and type I interferon signalling

Cq4.label: Apoptosis of progenitors, growth failure and microcephaly

interventions.label: NAD+ precursor (niacin or nicotinamide riboside)
interventions.gating_biomarker: BUBR1 protein level in patient-derived cells; blood NAD+
interventions.rationale: SIRT2 raises BubR1 abundance in mice (North 2014), which is the mechanism relevant to a destabilised missense allele whose main measured defect is a lower protein level. No data in MVA patients or cells. Nicotinamide itself inhibits sirtuins at high dose and is avoided. Niacin is an approved medicine, nicotinamide riboside is a supplement. Severity includes the theoretical concern of supporting tumour growth.

interventions.label: JAK1/2 inhibitor (baricitinib), only if an interferon signature is present
interventions.rationale: Chromosome missegregation produces micronuclei that activate cGAS-STING; baricitinib has been used in paediatric interferonopathies. No evidence yet of an interferon signature in MVA1, so use is conditional on measuring it. Severity is high because of infection risk and the class warning on malignancy in a child with cancer predisposition.

interventions.label: Intermittent dasatinib (senolytic), alone or with quercetin
interventions.rationale: In BubR1-insufficient progeroid mice, genetic clearance of p16-positive cells delays age-related pathology, which is in vivo evidence in the same gene. Dasatinib itself was not tested in that model. Haematological and pleural toxicity matter in a child with a fragile marrow.

interventions.label: Translational readthrough (gentamicin) for the nonsense allele
interventions.gating_biomarker: full-length BUBR1 by immunoblot in patient-derived cells
interventions.rationale: The nonsense allele creates a premature stop codon whose identity and local context are determined per patient (readthrough check; UGA has the highest basal readthrough), but NMD is predicted (B1 remains), so clearing B2 alone cannot restore the allele. Ataluren is not available in the EU (marketing authorisation not renewed, expired 28 March 2025) and is not FDA-approved. Aminoglycosides are oto- and nephrotoxic. Gentamicin response depends on local sequence context (a U at -1 is the main determinant).

interventions.label: Type I interferon receptor blockade (anifrolumab), only if an interferon signature is present
interventions.rationale: Found by the database screen, not by the manual review. Monoclonal antibody against IFNAR1: blocks type I interferon signalling at the receptor, narrower than JAK1/2 inhibition. Approved for adult lupus; paediatric approval was not found, so any use in a child would be off-label. No evidence in MVA. Severity is provisional (7): infection risk and the class caution for immunosuppression in a cancer-prone child; one point below baricitinib because it is narrower, which is a judgement.

exclusions.label: MPS1/TTK inhibitors
exclusions.reason: Abrogate the spindle checkpoint in every cell, and in this genotype every cell is already compromised; no healthy population to spare. Relevant only to a tumour, never as systemic therapy. Not approved.

exclusions.label: Microtubule agents (benzimidazoles, taxanes, vinca alkaloids)
exclusions.reason: Perturb the spindle and raise the chance of mis-segregation. A weakened checkpoint allows slippage, so cells escape arrest with damage. The 'speed bump' idea is backwards.

exclusions.label: HDAC inhibitors
exclusions.reason: Histone hyperacetylation in mitosis has been reported to cause segregation defects; no support for strengthening the centromere.

exclusions.label: ATR/CHK1 inhibitors
exclusions.reason: Force mitotic entry with damage, which would be toxic to normal tissue; not approved.

exclusions.label: Fatty-acid-synthesis inhibition to starve aneuploid cells
exclusions.reason: Selective killing of aneuploid cells has not been shown in vivo and a systemic approach is unsafe in a child.

exclusions.label: Direct cGAS or STING inhibitors
exclusions.reason: No approved agent; the approved route into the pathway is JAK inhibition (I2).

exclusions.label: Nicotinamide as an NAD+ source
exclusions.reason: At high dose it inhibits sirtuins, the opposite of the intended effect; niacin or nicotinamide riboside are preferred.

exclusions.label: AMPK activation (metformin) for micronucleus clearance
exclusions.reason: Weak, indirect link to this mechanism.

uncertainty.relevance_note: r = P(the BUB1B pair is the disease-causing compound heterozygous genotype) = P(alleles in trans) x P(missense allele is hypomorphic). Root-tier interventions only help if it is true; consequence-tier ones act on harm that is present whatever the cause (and are gated by a biomarker).

modifier.label: additional heterozygous loss-of-function variant in a tumour-predisposition gene (identified in the same genome)

screen_review.PACLITAXEL PROTEIN-BOUND: microtubule agent (class X2); the BCL2 record is incidental
screen_review.TIRBANIBULIN: inhibits tubulin polymerisation as well as Src (class X2)
screen_review.OBLIMERSEN: BCL2 antisense; withdrawn or not marketed, treat as not available
screen_review.VANDETANIB: oncology kinase inhibitor with many targets; Src record not specific
screen_review.BOSUTINIB: oncology kinase inhibitor; same class concerns as dasatinib
screen_review.IBRUTINIB: oncology BTK inhibitor; Src record secondary
screen_review.ACALABRUTINIB: oncology BTK inhibitor; Src record secondary
screen_review.VENETOCLAX: BCL2 inhibitor, oncology; neutropenia; senolytic use only experimental
screen_review.NAVITOCLAX: BCL2/BCL-xL inhibitor; thrombocytopenia; not approved in most settings
screen_review.AMLEXANOX: TBK1 inhibitor; approval is regional (not scored)
screen_review.REPOTRECTINIB: oncology kinase inhibitor; JAK2 record secondary
